description: Repairs r-fmt-1/create-mdb-datetime2 and r-fmt-1/read-mdb-datetime2: CREATE TABLE T with the DATETIME2 column was refused in the Jet 4 MDB (3001), so T was never created and the follow-up open failed with 3011. Asks, on a new MDB database from CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 64) kept as a fixture: T(ID Long primary key) is created on its own; the field list is read; ALTER TABLE T ADD COLUMN V DATETIME2 runs as its own statement with dbFailOnError and DBEngine.Errors; the (refreshed) field list is read again; a Null row (ID 1) is inserted by SQL and VT_DATE 1.5 is put through a table-type recordset (IDs 2 and up) with DBEngine.Errors read after each put and update; then the user-table view is read, the file is closed and kept, and the view is read again after a read-only reopen.
